title: Schema + helpers for Auto-from-class generation (no UI yet)
description: Add the data layer required for class-aware worksheet generation. Introduce a GenerationMode type, a buildClassAutoBrief() helper that aggregates pupil context for a whole class, and aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief() that wraps the existing aiGenerateWorksheet call with that brief. No UI changes — the next PR consumes these.
rationale: We want the form-vs-auto switch in PR-2 to be a thin UI on top of well-tested data and AI helpers. Doing the schema and pure functions in their own PR lets us add unit tests and keeps PR-2 small.
steps: In client/src/lib/pupil-context.ts, add a new function buildClassAutoBrief(classId: string): ClassAutoBrief that aggregates over all pupils in the class. ClassAutoBrief shape:
classId: string;
classLabel: string;            // human-readable, e.g. '7B2 Maths'
suggestedTopic: string;        // from scheduler-store next-due topic, fall back to last-taught
pupilCount: number;
tierMix: { foundation: number; core: number; higher: number; send: number };  // counts
readingAgeRange: { min: number; max: number };
recentMisconceptions: string[]; // pulled from the most recent ScanMark batch for this class, top 5
sendNeeds: string[];           // distinct EHCP/SEND tags across the class
pupilSummaries: Array<{ pupilId: string; tier: 'foundation'|'core'|'higher'|'send'; readingAge: number; topNeed: string|null }>;

Source data: read pupils via the existing children store (search for `useChildren` or `children-store.ts`), recent scan results via lib/scan-mark.ts (look for `getRecentScanResults` or similar), scheduler via lib/scheduler-store.ts loadScheduler().

Make buildClassAutoBrief synchronous and pure (no AI calls, no fetches). All inputs come from in-memory stores. If a class has no scan history, recentMisconceptions = []. If a class has no scheduler entry, suggestedTopic = '' and the caller is expected to surface that.

Add a sibling helper classAutoBriefIsUsable(brief): boolean that returns true iff pupilCount >= 1 and (suggestedTopic !== '' OR caller will provide a topic). PR-2 uses this to decide whether to show the auto panel as actionable.
In client/src/lib/ai/generate.ts (introduced by PR-0), add a new exported wrapper:
export async function aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief(
brief: ClassAutoBrief,
overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof aiGenerateWorksheet>[0]> = {}
): Promise<ReturnType<typeof aiGenerateWorksheet>>

It must derive subject/yearGroup/topic/sendNeed from the brief, then merge `overrides` on top, then delegate to aiGenerateWorksheet. It must NOT introduce a new prompt — only an additional 'Class context' system message appended to the existing prompt array, summarising tierMix, readingAgeRange, and the top 3 recentMisconceptions.
Re-export ClassAutoBrief and aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief from client/src/lib/ai/index.ts.
Add tests:

- client/src/lib/__tests__/buildClassAutoBrief.test.ts — covers: no pupils returns pupilCount=0; mixed tiers compute correct counts; recentMisconceptions are deduped and capped at 5; missing scheduler entry yields empty suggestedTopic.

- client/src/lib/__tests__/aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief.test.ts — mocks aiGenerateWorksheet, asserts it is called once with the expected merged params and that overrides win over brief-derived values.
do_not_touch: The aiGenerateWorksheet prompt itself — only append a class-context message
acceptance_criteria: buildClassAutoBrief is pure, synchronous, returns the documented shape, and is unit-tested for: empty class, mixed tiers, missing scheduler entry, no scan history, top-5 misconception cap.
aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief delegates to aiGenerateWorksheet exactly once and respects override precedence.
No existing import path breaks. pnpm run check + pnpm run build pass.
Tests pass: pnpm test --run buildClassAutoBrief aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: LOW. PR-0 has already shrunk ai.ts. Read only generate.ts (small after split), pupil-context.ts (currently 141 lines, fully readable), and the test files. No need to read Worksheets.tsx at all.
